Taxes and fees at Birmingham hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($21 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Hilton Birmingham Downtown at UAB to 22% at Ramada by Wyndham Birmingham Airport. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
